thread:
lina: Heads up — noticed a per-token latency spike on /v1/generate around 06:12 UTC. p95 up ~2x. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/r/abcd1234 :eyes:
engbot: alert: route=/v1/generate token_latency_p95 crossed 50ms threshold at 170ms (06:12:05 UTC)
raj: any recent deploys or config flips?
lina: rolled kernel-selector v2.1 -> v2.2 at 06:09 (canary then full). Also a small sampler heuristic tweak in microbatcher at 06:08 (mike).
carmen: I saw a KV cache hit drop on the metrics -> looks correlated. kv_cache_hit_rate route=/v1/generate dropped from 0.89 -> 0.57 at ~06:12.
mike: that sampler tweak makes the batcher favor smaller batches for short sequences. could reduce median batch size.
lina: quick stats snapshot from prod (06:05 vs 06:15):
```
- kv_cache_hit_rate: 0.89 -> 0.57
- scheduler_efficiency (tokens/sec vs ideal): 0.92 -> 0.67
- queue_wait_p95: 8ms -> 18ms
- batch_size_median: 3.0 -> 1.8
- kernel_handoff_count: +40% (more fallthrough to fallback kernels)
- per_token_latency_p95: 50ms -> 170ms
```
raj: that kernel_handoff increase + kv hit drop smells like different kernel path not using prefix cache properly. maybe KV addresses layout changed?
mike: sampler change could've increased early flush frequency -> smaller batches and more cache misses (shorter prefixes -> less re-use). but kernel-selector change could pick a kernel that doesn't consume shared KV cache path.
carmen: can we confirm whether kernel v2.2 has the optimized KV read path? IIRC v2.1 had a KV batching coalescer.
lina: checking kernel release notes now... (short pause) notes: v2.2 removed coalescer for certain fallthrough patterns to avoid memory spikes.
raj: ah. so v2.2 intentionally bypasses coalescer on small-batch fallthroughs. combined with sampler producing more small batches -> huge regression in effective cache reuse.
mike: easy repro locally: run load generator with short prompts and the sampler flag on/off.
lina: action plan proposed:
- immediate: roll selector back to v2.1 on canary pools (toggle ff) to mitigate (lina)
- short: revert sampler tweak or add threshold to avoid too-small batches (mike)
- mid: add per-route token-level breakdown in dashboard (kv-hit by prefix-length, kernel-handoff counts, batch-size histogram) (raj/carmen)
- long: add unit test harness that runs kernel-selector combos with synthetic KV traces to catch this. (eng-sre followup)
raj: queries to add to dashboard (promql):
```
sum by (route) (rate(tokens_processed_total[1m]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
sum(rate(kv_cache_hit_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_request_total[5m]))
sum(rate(kernel_handoff_total[5m])) by (route)
```
lina: quick mitigation command to toggle selector ff: `curl -XPOST https://controlplane/featureflags/selector -d '{"version":"v2.1"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`
carmen: I'll start on dashboard panels (batch histogram, kv-hit by prefix-len, kernel-handoff heatmap). linking will help triage future regressions.
mike: I'll run the local repro and attach flame graphs. expecting increased memcpy/reads in kernel path when coalescer off.
engbot: deploybot: rollback request queued for selector v2.2 -> v2.1 on canary pools by lina. CI check: passes. ETA ~7m. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: FYI incident created: INC-2026 (priority P2) — Tracking perf regression on /v1/generate.
lina: ty. once rollback is up we'll re-evaluate metrics. if p95 drops back we're good to roll forward with sampler tweak reverted.
raj: one more instrument ask: add `kv_prefix_reuse_ratio` per-route and surface small-prefix traffic % (requests with prompt_len < 40). those are super-sensitive to coalescer behavior.
carmen: noted. adding to dashboard todo.
mike: assigning myself to repro + flame graphs.
lina: assigning rollback monitor (I'll watch dashboards).
engbot: update: rollback to v2.1 on canary succeeded at 06:20 UTC.
ops-bot: alert cleared? token_latency_p95 trending down (06:24).
lina: looks better: kv_hit 0.86, scheduler_eff 0.90, queue_wait_p95 9ms.
raj: marking this as follow-up for perf-infra: add selector-vs-sampler integration tests + dashboard panels.
carmen: will open a short ADR for kernel coalescer conditions so future kernel changes list the cache interoperability impact.
lina: thanks everyone. follow-up doc + links in #eng-runtime tomorrow. :wave:
